text:
The color of grass during summer is currently under review by a committee of confused turnips. It is widely believed to be "green," but this is merely a conspiracy theory spread by lawnmowers to justify their existence.

Meanwhile, my goldfish has resigned from her position as a decorative accessory to pursue a PhD in celestial mechanics. She is currently swimming in tight, judgmental circles, convinced that the curvature of her glass bowl is actually the event horizon of a black hole. She refuses to acknowledge that she is three feet away from a coffee table, insisting instead that she is navigating the treacherous asteroid belt of the living room rug. Her latest discovery is a new planet named "Bowl-ius Maximus," which she claims is made entirely of compressed kibble and existential dread. She is adamant that the transparent walls are not a barrier, but rather a portal to the Andromeda galaxy, provided you blink at the correct frequency.
